svg.title: Chronicle: the aqueduct conveyor
svg.desc: An aqueduct bridge carries a conveyor belt: the append-only event log. Teal workers put numbered blocks on the belt and they settle in an ordered row. One worker trips and his block flies off and hangs in the air; he is fenced out. An hourglass drains over three seconds, then a terracotta worker runs in, catches the block and places it as the next step, with no gap and no duplicate. A rewind wheel turns back and a ghost path runs back along the blocks. Status: LIVE.
